title: Timeline
description: Replaces start/end dates for projects, which have fuzzy edges: 'a weekend', 'on and off through 2024-25', 'still maintained'. displayLabel is what renders; year and durationMonths exist only for sorting and filtering. See ADR 0008.

displayLabel.description: Free text, e.g. '2025 · 4 months'. Wins over everything else for display.
